summary: BitVec::from_bitslice, also used by BitSlice::to_owned, cloned underlying storage elements without realigning a partial-element head. The fix collects the slice's logical bits into a new vector, packing them from the start of its storage. The fix adds tests/issue_10.rs, whose root-level issue_10 test copies bits 4..12 and checks equality, individual bits, and packed storage. Both proposed implementation regions occur exactly once in their respective revisions. No tests were run.
